backend: Full-path tempered sequential Monte Carlo with covariance-preconditioned symmetric Metropolis moves
selected_scope: Desktop retained-history posterior for all16 current quantities; finite short fixtures first; no canonical aging run

alternatives.joint_path_MAP: Does not compute marginal uncertainty or relative integrated mode mass
alternatives.bootstrap_particle_filter_without_rejuve: Static-parameter and ancestral path diversity can collapse
alternatives.single_local_Gaussian: Would assume the representation whose sufficiency is still at issue
alternatives.gradient_MCMC: Possible later comparator; bounds, mixture exploration and path conditioning need separate registration

measure.initial: original16 x = public_mean + public_sd*u; exact two-component logQ mixture and original rectangular support
measure.health: y_j = previous_j + declared_mean_increment + sqrt(v_j)*u_j; zero-v coordinates eliminated
measure.prior_sampling: Original independent truncated coordinates, mixture label AND value redrawn on capacity rejection; normalized health draws by rejection; entire path redrawn when physical support fails
measure.constants: All original prior and voltage constants retained in evaluator; normalizing constant of full supported path prior unknown but cancels within fixed-query posterior. SMC evidence is conditional on that normalized supported prior, not an absolute likelihood across different physical-support contracts.
measure.query: Complete retained prefix only; no inherited posterior added as an extra factor

numerics.safe_normalizer: erfc tails when probability >=0.01; otherwise qualified scalar scaled integral. Unresolved arithmetic propagates, never becomes zero particle mass.
numerics.initial_population: draw from declared prior, no truth or optimized centers
numerics.proposal_covariance: Weighted current path covariance, frozen within stage; ridge1e-8*max(diagonal,1e-4)
numerics.reported_weight_ESS: Incremental importance-weight diagnostic only, never posterior independent sample count
numerics.acceptance_diagnostics: all per-stage fractions and surviving initial ancestor counts retained; no convergence inferred from these alone

adequacy.kind: Finite independently replicated moment/quantile/evidence diagnostics, not a universal convergence proof or calibrated coverage
adequacy.failure: uncertainty_unresolved; raw approximate populations retained as diagnostic only
adequacy.compression_density_contrast_0_1_NLL_gat: not qualified by sample moments; requires separate density/message comparison

cases: vectorized full-path density and current-state parity with qualified scalar kernels including Jacobian
bounded original prior and capacity-mixture moments
two-mode marginal masses versus analytic mixture posterior
conditional bounded R0 marginal versus independent quadrature
full16 dynamic prediction and conditioning at current boundary
qualification.known_posterior_gate: mean and mode-mass errors <= max(5*independent-replicate MCSE,0.04 posterior SD or0.01 mass); variance/covariance errors <=max(5*MCSE,0.06 marginal SD product)
qualification.voltage_origin: Declared finite fixture measurements; no plant truth file, fit or truth scoring
qualification.rate_scope: Artificial conditioning fixture, not calibrated aging
qualification.boundary_reports: Separate prediction with final voltage masked and full conditioning. Prediction increments/variance changes computed between last two health boundaries under the predictive path posterior, explicitly conditional on valid path support.

failure_policy: Collect independent finite case failures; preserve sources, seeds, samples, all statuses and receipts. No automatic rerun or tolerance changes. Development corrections use new named snapshots and a written reason.

method_source.attribution: Del Moral,Doucet,Jasra2006:SMC samplers over intermediate distributions with weighting/resampling/Markov moves. Does not validate this implementation or finite adequacy thresholds.

development_revision: See development_review.json; thresholds and model unchanged, more particles/mutations and smaller proposals after stationary tail-quantile failure.
